output.question: Who is Accenture's CTO?
output.answer: Dr. Marc Warner is Accenture's Chief Technology Officer. He is the co-founder and CEO of the London AI firm Faculty. He took the CTO role when Accenture completed its acquisition of Faculty on March 16, 2026, and he also joined Accenture's Global Management Committee. Coverage from October 17, 2026 still calls him Accenture's CTO. Separately, Rajendra Prasad leads Accenture's 'Technology' Reinvention Engine. Some Accenture leadership pages give Prasad the title 'Group Chief Executive – Technology and Chief Technology Officer', but those pages may be out of date.

key_facts.fact: When Accenture completed its acquisition of Faculty, Faculty CEO and co-founder Dr. Marc Warner expanded his role to also become Accenture's chief technology officer, and he joined Accenture's Global Management Committee.
National CIO Review reported that Accenture appointed Dr. Marc Warner as CTO after the Faculty deal closed.
An October 2026 article still calls Marc Warner Accenture's chief technology officer. It covers his remarks at a Fortune Brainstorm AI session.
In Accenture's Reinvention Services leadership announcement, Rajendra Prasad leads 'Technology', one of three Reinvention Engines. That announcement does not call him CTO.

passages.quote: Faculty CEO and co-founder Dr. Marc Warner expands his role to also become chief technology officer of Accenture
Accenture has appointed Dr. Marc Warner as Chief Technology Officer
Accenture's chief technology officer, Marc Warner
Technology, led by Rajendra Prasad, which will build and scale advanced technology capabilities.

caveats: Search snippets of Accenture leadership-bio pages (e.g., accenture.com/fi-en/about/leadership/rajendra-prasad) describe Rajendra Prasad as 'Group Chief Executive – Technology and Chief Technology Officer'. I did not open those pages and could not confirm when they were last updated. They may predate Warner's March 2026 appointment.
Warner holds the CTO role alongside his position as Faculty CEO. The Accenture release did not say whether he replaced a previous CTO.
The newest confirmation (October 17, 2026) comes from a secondary outlet, not from Accenture. A change between then and November 11, 2026 cannot be ruled out, but I found no report of one.
